# BPM / Laws+ compatibility patch - events
# Generated by tools/build.py. Do not rename: the zzzzzzzzzz_ prefix keeps
# these files last in the ASCII order the game resolves conflicts by.

# peoples_springtime.8
peoples_springtime.8 = {
	type = country_event

	event_image = {
		video = "middleeast_police_breaking_door"
	}

	on_created_soundeffect = "event:/SFX/UI/Alerts/event_appear"

	icon = "gfx/interface/icons/event_icons/event_protest.dds"

	title = peoples_springtime.8.t
	desc = peoples_springtime.8.d
	flavor = peoples_springtime.8.f

	duration = 3

	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_variable = completed_peoples_springtime }
		OR = {
			AND = {
				has_variable = peoples_springtime_fully_ended
				bpm_country_is_republic = no
				NOT = {
					any_interest_group = {
						bpm_ig_is_radical_left = yes
						bpm_ig_is_marginal = no
					}
				}
			}
			has_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
			AND = {
				var:springtime_timer_var >= 12
				any_political_movement = {
					OR = {
						is_political_movement_type = movement_german_national
						is_political_movement_type = movement_italian_national
						is_political_movement_type = movement_radical
					}
					political_movement_support <= 0.10
					is_being_suppressed = yes
				}
				NOT = {
					any_scope_character = {
						OR = {
							is_interest_group_leader = yes
							has_role_of_type = agitator
						}
						has_ideology = ideology:ideology_radical
					}
				}
				NOT = {
					has_variable = completed_peoples_springtime
				}
			}
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		set_variable = {
			name = completed_peoples_springtime
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
			}
			remove_variable = red_summer_the_revolution_vanquished
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.8.a
		add_modifier = {
			name = counter_revolutionary_fervor
			days = normal_modifier_time
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = peoples_springtime.8.b
		default_option = yes
		add_loyalists = {
			value = 0.1
		}
	}

	after = {
		je:je_springtime_of_the_peoples ?= {
			remove_involved_country = ROOT
		}
	}
}
